self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Rebellious Guardian: While protected by the shield generated on taking DMG, the character gains 24% increased DMG. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

en.flavor: A heavy greatsword. A clock is embedded within it, though its internal mechanisms have long been damaged.

refinements.1: Taking DMG generates a shield which absorbs DMG up to <r>20%</r> of Max HP. This shield lasts for 10s or until broken, and can only be triggered once every <v>45</v>s. While protected by a shield, the character gains <r>12%</r> increased DMG.
refinements.2: Taking DMG generates a shield which absorbs DMG up to <r>23%</r> of Max HP. This shield lasts for 10s or until broken, and can only be triggered once every <v>45</v>s. While protected by a shield, the character gains <r>15%</r> increased DMG.
refinements.3: Taking DMG generates a shield which absorbs DMG up to <r>26%</r> of Max HP. This shield lasts for 10s or until broken, and can only be triggered once every <v>45</v>s. While protected by a shield, the character gains <r>18%</r> increased DMG.
refinements.4: Taking DMG generates a shield which absorbs DMG up to <r>29%</r> of Max HP. This shield lasts for 10s or until broken, and can only be triggered once every <v>45</v>s. While protected by a shield, the character gains <r>21%</r> increased DMG.
refinements.5: Taking DMG generates a shield which absorbs DMG up to <r>32%</r> of Max HP. This shield lasts for 10s or until broken, and can only be triggered once every <v>45</v>s. While protected by a shield, the character gains <r>24%</r> increased DMG.

fr.flavor: Une grande épée lourde équipée d'une cloche, mais dont le mécanisme de chronométrage a été détruit il y a bien longtemps.

refinements.5: Subir des DGT génère un bouclier qui absorbe jusqu'à <r>32 %</r> des PV max pendant 10 s, cet effet pouvant être déclenché une fois toutes les <v>45</v> s. Lorsque le personnage est sous la protection du bouclier, les DGT infligés augmentent de <r>24 %</r>.

pt.flavor: Um espadão pesado com um relógio, mas seus mecanismos internos foram danificados.

refinements.5: Ao receber dano, cria um escudo que absorve o equivalente a <r>32%</r> da Vida Máxima por 10s ou até o escudo desaparecer. Pode ser ativado uma vez a cada <v>45</v>s. Quando o personagem estiver com o escudo, o Dano causado aumenta <r>24%</r>.
